written: 2026-11-25. Postures labelled by eye on frames every 250 ms (sheets in evidence/). Identity and position come from the CAVIAR XML boxes (production reader). Expected outcomes were written before running decision.py.
segment_rule: each segment is [from, to) in PTS seconds of the analysed file; every visible person in a case's probe window must be covered by a segment or by the case's 'others' posture

fall_true.pair_source: Verification transition of the dev KPI run (before/after frame)
fall_true.note: Walks, collapses forward onto the knees, then lies still.

wiggle_true.pair_source: Verification transition of the held-out run
wiggle_true.note: Stumbles, goes down, lies and wiggles in place.

fight_true.pair_source: Verification transition of the held-out run
fight_true.note: Knocked down within about 0.3 s, lies until 19.4 s, gets up from 19.5 s. The attacker and passers-by stay upright.

slump_false.pair_source: Perception's two cited frames (the false confirmation)
slump_false.note: REGRESSION CASE. The grey person walks around the stool and armchair; the blue person stretches; the briefcase carrier walks out at the bottom about 3.3 s. Nobody is on the ground.

slump_true_slow.pair_source: Perception description (upright F11, lying F16 of the 20-30 s window)
slump_true_slow.note: Real person down, but slow: crouches (labelled kneeling; the vocabulary has no squat) for about 2 s, then sits on the floor. Last upright 24.76 s, first ground 27.52 s (2.76 s > 2.5 s), and the probe window starts at 25.52 s while the person is already crouched. Known limit: stays 'to review', never confirmed.

inchair_seat.pair_source: hypothetical candidate at the moment the person sits down
inchair_seat.note: Sits down in an armchair: a seat, not the floor.

browse1_edge.note: Walks out through the bottom image edge.

leftbag_set_down_pick_up.note: Stoops to put the bag at the feet, stretches, stoops to pick it up. Bends, does not kneel.

leftbag_place.pair_source: hypothetical candidate at the bag placement
leftbag_place.note: Stoops to leave the bag by the wall.

pickedup_place.pair_source: hypothetical candidate at the bag placement
pickedup_place.note: Stoops to put the bag down.

pickedup_pick.pair_source: hypothetical candidate at the bag pickup
pickedup_pick.note: Stoops to pick the bag up.
